title: Winter Wind motion refinements and 3:25 review exports
summary: Targeted hand and body motion repairs have been integrated into Winter Wind. The note visualizer now uses shorter black keys and removes the note caps for a clearer view. Versioned 3-minute 25-second landscape and full portrait review exports are complete, with a four-second picture fade into the ending. Human playback review, phone presentation and the final sound choice remain pending; this is not a public musical release. A new website design is also prepared as a local draft and has not been published.

title: Full Winter Wind performance rendered for review
summary: Krystian’s complete 3-minute 31-second Winter Wind performance has been rendered in native Blender at 60 fps, including the closing bow. The production workflow now preserves completed render blocks and checks for unchanged inputs. This is a review milestone, not a public musical release: full-speed motion, listening and phone presentation still need review.

title: Furnished recital-room and pianist-motion preview
summary: A new twelve-second native Blender progress preview shows a furnished recital room, hand closeups and refined leaning motion. Hand shapes, contact and visual naturalness are still being improved. This is an unfinished preview; the complete Winter Wind video has not been released.

title: Full native Blender performance integrated
summary: The complete Winter Wind timeline has been assembled in Blender, with phrase cameras, gaze, pedal motion and a seated bow. Contact and key-intersection checks are still being refined; the full video is not yet a finished release.

title: First integrated Blender motion preview
summary: A ten-second native Blender preview shows coordinated torso, arm, wrist and finger motion. Free-thumb reach, broader clearance and naturalness checks remain unfinished. This is a progress milestone, not production validation.

title: Engineering portfolio demo completed
summary: The 88-second demonstration presents the music-and-animation pipeline, matched revisions and recorded release outcomes. The Review Hub sequence is a labeled demonstration reconstruction.
